body:
Several things need to be changed on these pull requests, so the unit tests serve their intended need, some of which I am not clear yet due to how much overhead you will need to generate the required input to the functions.

I think for now, start by just remaking the unit test that checks the perceval function and post to the Pull Request comments. I want to make sure we are on the same page in regards to loading the tools.yml for the user, and the assumption of path, as this applies to every unit test. 

Also, note you are using a function (expect_no_error) that is only available on a more recent version of test that, which may be 3.1.7. Can you check which version introduces that? We need to update it on the DESCRIPTION file. We shouldn't specify 3.1.7 if it is on an earlier version, so it is not so strict on the user to update.

@nicoelee123 

Here are some more specific change requests. I asked in the past that the test descriptions are reworded properly. The later unit tests without comments on this review are fine. But the starting unit tests (at the start of the file) need some editing. I noted down the replacements. Please make sure the other Pull Request for Malia has test descriptions that conform to these. 

One unit test should be removed, other modified, etc.

Finally there is a warning being generated that needs to be addressed.

Can you give me an OK on the other pull request that it accounts for the review recommendations here before I try them and link to this comment on it?

Let me know if you have any questions. 

Thanks.
Ok, this is passing locally for me too. I will try to diagnose the remote myself down the road since this is secondary.
